notes.title: Game updates and new demo
notes.content:
As Glacial was the first full game i had developed, since its time of release i have learnt a lot in ways to improve the player experience. [b]What changes have been made?
[/b]

- [b]New area [/b]has been added to the map.

- The camera effects have been completely re-done, creating a more [b]visually 
pleasing experience[/b] for the player.

- Two [b]new scares[/b] have been added to the game.

- An[b] objective system[/b] is now in place, helping give the player direction.

- An option to [b]turn off enemys[/b] and player deaths has been added, allowing those who prefer a more casual style of horror to enjoy the game.

-[b] Improved optimisation [/b], the cameras range has been decreased creating higher frame rates and a smoother player experience. 

- [b]A free demo[/b] has been added allowing you to play the first section of the game, or until the player has decided if this game is for them.
